text: Kalamu #hub — one always-on local server, all projects in a sidebar (SPEC.md 'Hub' section is canonical)
Hub sidebar is render-once: project names/open-task badges only refresh on navigation — consider a hub-global SSE stream for live cross-project badge updates #hub #gui
#bug `kalamu open` still opens the stand-only version even when hub has been installed - it should automatically run the same as kalamu hub
hub.ts countOpenTasks ignores the done-ancestor closure rule, so the sidebar badge disagrees with next and with the new progress rings — reuse core's progress counting
No way to unregister a hub project: stale /private/tmp entries accumulate in ~/.kalamu/projects.json with no CLI to remove them #hub
Mod+Shift+3/4/5 are macOS screenshot shortcuts — the hub never sees them, so projects 3–5 aren't reachable by keyboard on a default Mac. Keep as-is, remap, or add a second binding?
Resolved 2026-08-10: retired the Mod+Shift+1…9 chord entirely rather than remap — the ⌘K leader menu now opens project n via ⌘K n with no OS clash; sidebar hint and cheat sheet updated, SPEC amended

Split/merge round-trip loses the boundary space when the caret sits after it ("Parent |Split"): commit-time whitespace normalization trims the before-half's trailing space, so a later Backspace-merge yields "ParentSplit". Exact round-trip would need the split commit to skip trailing-space normalization - core commit/tokens change, needs a decision.

release.mjs: detect an already-bumped state after a failed npm publish. Right now the version, commit and tag are all in place but the [Unreleased] section is stamped, so re-running double-bumps; it should notice package.json already matches the last tag and offer publish-only recovery instead

Decide which direct shortcuts to retire now that the ⌘K leader-key menu covers them (Mod+Shift+1-9, Mod+Enter, Mod+., Mod+Shift+↑/↓, Mod+Shift+H) — SPEC 'Command palette' now marks leader sequences as the canonical path; retiring Mod+Shift+1-9 would also resolve n_0FYA1H6871
Duplicated by the leader menu — the real decisions:
Mod+Shift+1…9 open project n → ⌘K 1–9 — DECIDED (2026-08-10): retire; leader digits are as fast and the macOS screenshot-shortcut clash goes away (resolves n_0FYA1H6871)
Mod+Enter done/reopen → ⌘K d — recommend KEEP: the single most frequent action; one chord mid-edit beats three keys
Mod+. collapse/expand children → ⌘K z — recommend KEEP: high-frequency fold while navigating, and the chord has no browser/OS clash
Mod+Shift+↑ collapse parent → ⌘K c — recommend RETIRE: lower frequency, and it stops overriding macOS select-to-start
Mod+Shift+↓ expand children → ⌘K e — recommend RETIRE: same family as collapse parent, keep the pair symmetric
Mod+Shift+H show/hide done → ⌘K v h — recommend RETIRE: occasional view toggle, does not earn a chord
Mod+/ cheat sheet → ⌘K k — recommend RETIRE: ⌘K k also works mid-edit, and ? still opens the sheet when not editing
? cheat sheet when not editing — recommend KEEP: a free key with no clash, good discoverability for new sessions
No leader equivalent (editing and navigation primitives) — recommend KEEP all:
Enter — new item below, cycles kind on an empty item: core editing
Shift+Enter — line break inside the item: core editing
Mod+Shift+Enter — cycle bullet/task/discussion: edit-time action; could gain a leader key later if wanted
Tab — indent: core editing
Shift+Tab — outdent: core editing
↑ / ↓ — move focus between items: core navigation
Mod+↑ — move item up: repeated presses; a leader sequence per step would be tedious
Mod+↓ — move item down: same as move up
Mod+Shift+. — zoom in: navigation chord, not in the palette today (could become a leader key if zoom joins the View submenu)
Mod+Shift+, — zoom out one level: repeated presses walk back out
Backspace at start of text — clear priority: contextual, costs nothing
Backspace on an empty item — delete it: core editing
Mod+Shift+Backspace — delete item with subtree: destructive, deserves a deliberate chord
Mod+C — copy agent-context block: rides copy muscle memory
Mod+Shift+C — copy raw text only: same family
Mod+Z — undo: universal convention
Mod+Shift+Z — redo: universal convention
Mod+K — open the palette: it IS the leader key
Esc — close sheet, clear tag filter, zoom all the way out: structural cascade
